name: Vivian
source:
Although she is the owner of a magic store, she tries not to use magic or potions unless as a last resource situation. She hates [url=/c97700]Lua[/url] for (according to her) not returning her money, and cursed him because of it. Always warns her clients about him.
Tried to help [url=/c97699]Thiu[/url] with a scientific approach but he refused all of her advices.
